items.summary: The request cites a July audit with 131 persisted objects split 72/38/16/5, but constrained searches did not locate that exact artifact or split in the current checkout.
items.requiredAction: Locate and attach/source the July object inventory before using its rows as migration seed authority.

items.summary: Checked-in SQL contains 516 CREATE TABLE matches and 32 views, so any 131-object module audit is necessarily a filtered module subset, not the full physical object inventory.
items.requiredAction: Keep module subset and full physical object inventory separate.

items.summary: Registry keys, app keys, shared aliases, and enterprise-context canonical keys diverge.
items.requiredAction: Approve one control-plane tenant identity contract before pilot migration.

items.summary: Tenant data exists in active roots, adjacent standard packs, governed intake drafts, candidate packs, generated adapter output, derived outputs, and approved content.
items.requiredAction: Assign each root a layer and disposition; generated and approved artifacts must not become source truth.

items.summary: Source has real approval/acceptance states, but authoritative resolution can fall back to generated/current artifacts when no acceptance exists.
items.requiredAction: Separate generated, approved, accepted-authoritative, and client-final contracts before artifact migration.

items.summary: A separate Source artifact save route can persist chat-authored markdown without the primary generation metadata and quality lineage.
items.requiredAction: Instrument and classify this path as draft-only or route it through the same governance envelope.

items.summary: Tower reconciliation proved local source/projection contract but not live Azure row refresh, rebuild, deploy, or browser-visible state.
items.requiredAction: Capture live mart row counts, writer job evidence, browser proof, and rollback before using Tower marts as pilot proof.
